</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A6_zt8ejTAXgB49" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Escrow
with trustee </i>- The Company transfers funds to the trustee for its Series A, B, C and D bonds to cover principal and interest payments
prior to the payment date.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>MIP
escrow </i>accounts - The Company is required to make monthly escrow deposits for MIP on the HUD guaranteed mortgage
loans.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Other
escrow and debt deposits</i> &#8211; The Company funds various escrow accounts under certain of its loan agreements, primarily to cover
debt service on underlying loans.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Property
tax and insurance escrow</i> - The Company funds escrows for real estate taxes and insurance under certain of its loan agreements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Interest
and expense reserve bonds escrow -</i> The indentures for the Series A, B, C, and D Bonds require the funding of a six-month interest
reserve as well as an expense reserve. See Note 7 &#8211; Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>HUD
replacement reserves</i> - The Company is required to make monthly payments into an escrow for replacement and improvement of the project
assets covered by HUD guaranteed mortgage loans. A portion of the replacement reserves are required to be maintained until the applicable
loan is fully paid.</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Acquisition
of Properties</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On

of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company had leased <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--CumulativeNumberOfProperties_iI_uInteger_c20251231_z1hmoMH5OrV5" title="Number of properties leased"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:CumulativeNumberOfProperties" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000950" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Integer">133</ix:nonFraction></span> properties and <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--CumulativeNumberOfProperties_iI_uInteger_c20241231_zBs29AAMQO8j" title="Number of properties leased"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:CumulativeNumberOfProperties" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact000952" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Integer">114</ix:nonFraction></span> properties, respectively, to tenant/operators in the states
of Arkansas, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee and Texas. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, all
of the Company&#8217;s healthcare facilities were leased. Most of these facilities are leased on a triple-net basis, meaning that the
lessee (<i>i.e</i>., operator of the facility) is obligated under the lease for all expenses of the property in respect to insurance,
taxes and property maintenance, as well as the lease payments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Right
of use assets and operating lease liabilities are disclosed as separate line items in the consolidated balance sheets and are valued
based on the present value of the future minimum lease payments at lease commencement. As the Company&#8217;s leases do not provide an
implicit rate, the Company used its incremental borrowing rate based on the information available at the adoption date in determining
the present value of future payments. Lease expense is recognized on a straight-line basis over the lease term. The Company&#8217;s operating
lease obligation is for one skilled nursing facility. <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--LesseeOperatingLeaseDescription_c20250101__20251231_z7pUYX0ROChf" title="Lease description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001052" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseDescription">The lease expires on March 1, 2028 and has two five-year renewal options.</ix:nonNumeric></span> The lease
is a triple net lease, which requires the Company to pay real and personal property taxes, insurance expenses and all capital improvements.
The Company subleases the building as part of the Indiana master lease. Based on the sublease with the Company&#8217;s tenant, the tenant
is required to pay real and personal property taxes, insurance expenses and all capital improvements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company was party to approximately <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--NumberOfOutstandingCreditRelatedInstrument_iI_uInteger_c20251231_zmOf3PfvV1Za" title="Number of outstanding credit related instruments"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:NumberOfOutstandingCreditRelatedInstrument" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001138" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Integer">45</ix:nonFraction></span> and <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--NumberOfOutstandingCreditRelatedInstrument_iI_uInteger_c20241231_zxe1VmSgtJ3c" title="Number of outstanding credit related instruments"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:NumberOfOutstandingCreditRelatedInstrument" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001140" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Integer">43</ix:nonFraction></span> outstanding credit related instruments, respectively.
These instruments included note payable, credit facilities, mortgage notes, bonds and other credit obligations. Some of the instruments
include financial covenants. Covenant provisions include, but are not limited to, debt service coverage ratios, and minimum levels of
EBITDA (defined as earnings before interest, tax, and depreciation and amortization) or EBITDAR (defined as earnings before interest,
tax, depreciation and amortization and rental expense). Some covenants are based on annual financial metric measurements, and some are
based on quarterly financial metric measurements. The Company routinely tracks and monitors its compliance with its covenant provisions.
As of December 31, 2025, the Company was in compliance with all financial and administrative covenants.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTE
7. Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt (cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interest
</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Series A Bonds have an interest rate of <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zaXEPHjlmHzc" title="Debt instrument, rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001231" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.97</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum. In July 2024, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating for the
Series A Bonds of ilA+.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series A Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on March 31 and September 30 of each year. The interest rate may increase if
certain financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment
Terms </i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_z2C9oag8dNa1" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001233" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series A Bonds is payable in three annual installments due on September 30 of each of the years 2024 through
2026. The first two principal payments are equal to 6% of the original principal amount of the Series A Bonds, and the last principal
payment is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series A Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial
Covenants </i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series A Bonds, the Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The
application of the covenants is based on the consolidated financial statements of the Company as prepared under the GAAP accounting
method. The financial covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the consolidated equity of the Company (excluding minority rights), as set forth in the
Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements, will not be less than USD <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_z3MLdLrGryx8" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001235" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span>
million</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the ratio between the Financial Debt and EBITDA shall not exceed 10</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The DSCR shall not be less than 1.05</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend
Restrictions </i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
long as the Company does not breach any of the Financial Covenants, no distribution restriction shall hinder the Company. If the
Company is in non-compliance with one or more of the Financial Covenants, the Company can make a distribution in an amount that does
not exceed the amount required to meet the U.S. legal requirements applicable to REITs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

The Company&#8217;s bond rating ilA+ or equivalent is lowered</span></p>

stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interest</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

In June 2025, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating for the
Series B Bonds of ilA+.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series B Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on June 30 and December 31 of each year. The interest rate may increase if
certain financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment
Terms</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zVK1ttMZZkTi" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001267" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series B Bonds is payable in four annual installments due on June 30 of each of the years 2026 through 2029.
The first three principal payments are equal to 4% of the original principal amount of the Series B Bonds, and the last principal payment
is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series B Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial
Covenants</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series B Bonds, the Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The
application of the covenants is based on the consolidated financial statements of the Company as prepared under the GAAP accounting
method. The financial covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the consolidated equity of the Company (excluding minority rights), as set forth in the
Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements, will not be less than USD <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zh8jwAPgmN87" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001269" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span>
million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the ratio between the Financial Debt and EBITDA shall not exceed 10</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The DSCR shall not be less than 1.05</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend
Restrictions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
long as the Company does not breach any of the Financial Covenants, no distribution restriction shall hinder the Company. If the
Company is in non-compliance with one or more of the Financial Covenants, the Company can make a distribution in an amount that does
not exceed the amount required to meet the U.S. legal requirements applicable to REITs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">In the event that:</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The Company&#8217;s bond rating ilA+ or equivalent is lowered</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The financial debt to EBITDA ratio exceeds 8</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

EBITDA to total debt service payments fall below 1.10</span></p>

Consolidated Equity is less than USD $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zgzVHLDfBfgg" title="Equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001271" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">30</ix:nonFraction></span> million</span></p>

additional rate of <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zsSVACAiE8jl" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001273" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% will take place per deviation from the financial covenants, with a maximum additions rate not to exceed <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--MaximumLimitOfInterestRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zCepOKf9jgj9" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:MaximumLimitOfInterestRate" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001275" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>%
above the interest rate determined on the tender.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has committed not to pledge its assets under general liens without obtaining the consent in advance of the Bond holders. Nevertheless,
The Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also to provide guarantees; and its subsidiaries are entitled
to register liens, including general and specific, on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Additional
Bonds</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Inc
Company can issue additional Series B Bonds at any time and the series does not have a formal ceiling. However, the new issuances are
subject to regulatory oversight.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Redemption
Provisions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">The Company may, at its discretion, call the Series
B Bonds for early repayment. In the event of the redemption of all of the Series B Bonds, the Company would be required to pay the highest
of the following amounts:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the market value of the balance of the Series B Bonds in circulation which will be determined based on the average closing price of
the Series B Bonds for thirty (30) trading days before the date on which the board of directors resolves to undertake the early
redemption; or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the par value of the Series B Bonds available for early redemption in circulation (i.e., the principal balance of the Series B Bonds
plus accrued interest until the date of the actual early redemption); or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the balance of the payments under the Series B Bonds (consisting of future payments of principal and interest), when discounted to their
present value based on the annual yield of the Israeli government bonds plus an &#8220;additional rate&#8221; of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zmFV0ogvzx56" title="Prepayment additional rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001277" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.0</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of a majority of the Series B Bonds may accelerate repayment of the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the Company is transferred,
directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the Series B Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the Company such that the Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iii)
the ratio of the consolidated equity of the BVI Company to total consolidated assets of the BVI Company is below <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zHfVjUNAxXK5" title="Stockholders' equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001314" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">27</ix:nonFraction></span>%; or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iv)
the ratio of outstanding amount of the Series C Bonds to the fair market value of the collateral for the Series B Bonds exceeds <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zEPS8PoXnW8l" title="Fair market value of collateral"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001316" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">75</ix:nonFraction></span>%,</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">then,
in each case, the interest on the Series C Bonds will increase by an additional <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zUVBskudYF62" title="Interest increasing in additional percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001318" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually, but only once with respect to each failure
to meet these requirements. Compliance with these financial covenants is measured quarterly.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Additionally,
if a decline in the rating of the Series C Bonds should take place, then for each single ratings decrease, the interest will be increased
by<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_z97zW6TDqkN4" title="Interest rate penalty"> <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001320" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year, up to a maximum increment of <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zrY0oW3mtDOa" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001322" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
any case, the total increase in the interest rate as a result of the above adjustments will not exceed <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zTrQXPJ4XVHj" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001324" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year. The increases in
the interest rate will also be reversed if the BVI Company regains compliance.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Series C Bonds are secured by first mortgage liens on eight properties. In addition, the Series C Bonds are also secured by interest
and expenses reserves. The BVI Company has agreed not to pledge its assets pursuant to a general lien without obtaining the prior consent
of the holders of the Series C Bonds, provided that the BVI Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also
to provide guarantees and its subsidiaries are entitled to register general and specific liens on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

the terms of the indenture for the Series C Bonds, the BVI Company can take out properties from the collateral (in case of HUD refinancing)
or to add properties and increase the Series C Bonds as long as the ratio of outstanding amount of the Series C Bonds to fair market
value of the collateral is not more than 65%. In addition, starting from July 1, 2023, if the fair market value of the collateral is
below 55%, the BVI Company can request to release collateral so the fair market value will increase to 55%.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of a majority of the Series C Bonds may accelerate repayment of the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the
BVI Company is transferred, directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the
Series C Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the BVI Company such that the BVI Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
purposes of the Series C Bonds, the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; of the BVI Company are deemed to be Moishe Gubin and Michael
Blisko.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
June 2023, the BVI Company completed an initial offering on the TASE of Series D Bonds with a par value of NIS <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_uNIS_c20230601__20230630__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zX5mjKoRSUn4" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2023-06-012023-06-30_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001332" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">82.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million ($<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_c20230601__20230630__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zARZ3aNQ0xf1" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2023-06-012023-06-30_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001334" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">22.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million).
These Series D Bonds were issued at par. Offering and issuance costs of approximately $0.6 million were incurred at closing. In July
2023, the BVI Company issued an additional NIS <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn6n6_uNIS_c20230701__20230731__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_z6Lu5xgO4FJ" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2023-07-012023-07-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001336" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">70</ix:nonFraction></span> million ($<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_c20230701__20230731__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zr9eZFDnPmx" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2023-07-012023-07-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001338" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">19.2</ix:nonFraction></span> million) in Series D Bonds. On February 8, 2024, the BVI Company issued
additional Series D Bonds with a par value of NIS <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_c20240208__20240208__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_znUbIE26buQ7" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2024-02-082024-02-08_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001340" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">100.0</ix:nonFraction></span> million (gross) and raised a net amount of NIS <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts_pn5n6_uNIS_c20240208__20240208__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zOhCrYa4T6Da" title="Bonds value net of issuance costs"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts" contextRef="From2024-02-082024-02-08_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001342" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">98.2</ix:nonFraction></span> million ($<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts_pn5n6_c20240208__20240208__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_z4GFdR1RG6Z2" title="Bonds value net of issuance costs"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts" contextRef="From2024-02-082024-02-08_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001344" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">25.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million),
offering and issuance costs of approximately $<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--BondIssuanceCosts_iI_pn4n6_c20240208__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_ztqFikp6ALf4" title="Offering and issuance costs"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:BondIssuanceCosts" contextRef="AsOf2024-02-08_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001346" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">.05</ix:nonFraction></span> million incurred at closing.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Exchange
of Series D Bonds for Series A Bonds </b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
September 2024, the Company made an exchange tender offer of outstanding Series D Bonds for series A Bonds. The interest rate on Series
A Bonds is <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_dp_uPure_c20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zbBV6sIgrnmh"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2024-09-30_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001347" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.97</ix:nonFraction></span></span><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">%
per annum. The exchange offer rate was <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--ExchangeOfferRatePerBond_iI_c20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zdu1DdD6UWWi"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:ExchangeOfferRatePerBond" contextRef="AsOf2024-09-30_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001348" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.069964</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Series A Bonds per Series D Bonds. As a result of this offer,
<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--ProceedsFromBonds_pn5n6_uNIS_c20240901__20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zkid70xJ1TKd"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:ProceedsFromBonds" contextRef="From2024-09-012024-09-30_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001349" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">47.3</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">million NIS Series D Bonds ($<span id="xdx_907_ecustom--ProceedsFromBonds_pn5n6_c20240901__20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zspZUhCU8qzd"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:ProceedsFromBonds" contextRef="From2024-09-012024-09-30_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001350" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">12.7</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">million) were exchanged for NIS <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--ExchangeOfBonds_pn5n6_uNIS_c20240901__20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zFTVIyS7FHvg"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:ExchangeOfBonds" contextRef="From2024-09-012024-09-30_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001351" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">50.6</ix:nonFraction></span>
million Series A Bonds ($<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--ProceedsFromBonds_pn5n6_c20240901__20240930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_z3iY0lo2GIIb" title="Proceeds from bonds"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:ProceedsFromBonds" contextRef="From2024-09-012024-09-30_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001353" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">13.6</ix:nonFraction></span> million).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the outstanding balance of the Series D Bonds were $<span id="xdx_901_ecustom--Bonds_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zG7Jr662sr18" title="Proceeds from issuance of initial public offering"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:Bonds" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001355" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">55.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--Bonds_iI_pn5n6_c20241231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zyo6Og59hk3j" title="Bonds outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:Bonds" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001357" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">51.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million, respectively. Increase
in outstanding balance was due to a change in exchange rate.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interest</i></b></span></p>

Series D Bonds initially bore interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zGdfeQ4ZGtO3" title="Debt instrument, rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001359" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">9.1</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum. In June 2023, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating
for the Series D Bonds of ilA.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series D Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on March 31 and September 30 of each year. The interest rate may increase if
certain financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zFQ0jfMQVEN3" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001361" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series D Bonds is payable in three annual installments due on September 30 of each of the years 2024 through
2026. The first two principal payments are equal to 6% of the original principal amount of the Series D Bonds, and the last principal
payment is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series D Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series D Bonds, the BVI Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The application
of the covenants is based on the financial statements of the BVI Company as prepared under the IFRS accounting method. The financial
covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company may not be less than $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zISL8rjnGGLl" title="Equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001363" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">230</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the Consolidated stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company to its total Consolidated balance sheet may not be less than
<span id="xdx_905_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_z7nJhUifvBMl" title="Stockholder's equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001365" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

The ratio of the adjusted net financial debt to adjusted EBITDA of the BVI Company (for the past four quarters) may not exceed 12.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend
Restrictions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
indenture for the Series D Bonds limits the amount of dividends that may be paid by the BVI Company to its stockholders. The BVI Company
may not make any distribution unless all of the following conditions are fulfilled (with all amounts calculated under IFRS):</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The distribution amount may not exceed <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--DividendDistributionAmountPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zr4EiJGUtODb" title="Dividend distribution percentage ratio"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:DividendDistributionAmountPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001367" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">80</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the net profit after tax that is recognized in the most recent Consolidated financial
statements of the BVI Company, less profits or losses arising from a change in accounting methods, net of revaluation profits/losses
(that have not yet been realized) arising from a change in the fair value of the assets with respect to the fair value in the prior reporting
period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the consolidated stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company to its total consolidated balance sheet may not be less than
<span id="xdx_908_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zkFvtUgsnRl7" title="Stockholder's equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001369" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">30</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;The BVI Company&#8217;s equity at the end of the last quarter, before the distribution of dividends, less the dividends distributed,
may not be less than $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zw10U2y0PZG3" title="Stock holder's  equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001371" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">250</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

the event that:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(i)
the stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company (excluding minority interests) is less than $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zod05kLGlsdh" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001373" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">250</ix:nonFraction></span> million;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(ii)
the ratio of the adjusted net financial debt to adjusted EBITDA (for the latest four quarters) exceeds 11;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iii)
the ratio of the consolidated equity of the BVI Company to total consolidated assets of the BVI Company is below <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zYBvTtpyy7f2" title="Stockholders' equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001375" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">27</ix:nonFraction></span>%; or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">then,
in each case, the interest on the Series D Bonds will increase by an additional <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zP3NT3JLVmgj" title="Interest increasing in additional percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001377" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually, but only once with respect to each failure
to meet these requirements. Compliance with these financial covenants is measured quarterly.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Additionally,
if a decline in the rating of the Series D Bonds should take place, then for each single ratings decrease, the interest will be increased
by <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zp4phzWvvK4h" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001379" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year, up to a maximum increment of <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zXJbkNQYZgX5" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001381" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
any case, the total increase in the interest rate as a result of the above adjustments will not exceed <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_z7eoYtwSyEFa" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001383" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year. The increases in
the interest rate will also be reversed if the BVI Company regains compliance.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
BVI Company has committed not to pledge its assets under general liens without obtaining the consent in advance of the Bond holders.
Nevertheless, the BVI Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also to provide guarantees; and its subsidiaries
are entitled to register liens, including general and specific, on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of a majority of the Series D Bonds may accelerate repayment of the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the
BVI Company is transferred, directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the
Series D Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
purposes of the Series D Bonds, the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; of the BVI Company are deemed to be Moishe Gubin and Michael
Blisko.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the BVI Company such that the BVI Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>
